### REQ-020: Handle MQTT messages larger than the RX buffer (fragmented events)

- **Status:** DONE
- **Added:** 2026-07-02
- **Completed:** 2026-07-04
- **Verified by:** code review + idf.py build 2026-07-04 (reassembly via total_data_len/current_data_offset, 16 KB cap; broker large-payload test pending, no board attached)
- **Depends on:** REQ-003
- **Description:**

esp-mqtt delivers payloads larger than the client buffer (`CONFIG_THERMO_MQTT_BUFFER_SIZE`, default 2048) as multiple `MQTT_EVENT_DATA` events; only the first carries the topic. `MqttClient::handleEvent()` processes only events with `topic_len > 0` (`net/thermo_mqtt.cpp:267-275`), so a large message is forwarded **truncated to its first fragment** and the rest is dropped → `deserializeJson` fails → the command/config is silently lost. A multi-room building configuration JSON can plausibly exceed 2 KB. (Legacy PubSubClient dropped oversized packets whole — equally lossy but never parsed garbage.)

Fix: in `MQTT_EVENT_DATA`, use `event->total_data_len` and `event->current_data_offset` to reassemble the full payload (accumulate into a buffer keyed by the in-flight message; deliver the callback once complete). Enforce a sane max (e.g. 16 KB) and log + publish an error status when exceeded. Alternatively raise the buffer and explicitly reject fragmented messages with a clear error — but reassembly is preferred since config size grows with room count.

See finding F-8 in `doc/reports/2026-07-02_migration_code_review.md`.

- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - [ ] A `cmd/<deviceId>/set` payload of 3–6 KB (rooms array) is applied correctly (test against a real broker) — *pending, no board attached 2026-07-04*
  - [ ] Payload above the enforced max is rejected with an error log (and status message), not processed partially — *error log implemented (16 KB cap); status error message deferred to backend coordination; broker test pending 2026-07-04*
  - [ ] Normal small messages unaffected; no heap leak across many large messages (soak test) — *buffer shrink_to_fit after each message; soak pending 2026-07-04*
- **Notes:** `connected_` made `std::atomic<bool>` as suggested. Partial messages from a dropped connection are cleared on `MQTT_EVENT_DISCONNECTED`. Max payload documented in `doc/MQTT.md` "Payload size limits".
